observations: Multiple used car transmission cases are shown in a cluttered storage area.
The cases are heavily used, dirty, and show significant wear.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI LINKS AUTO' is visible across the center of the image.
The specific brand and model of the transmissions are not legible in the photo.

claims.claim: all kinds of cars spare parts
claims.evidence: This is a general business claim that cannot be verified from a single photo of a few used transmissions.

risks.risk: The photo may be a stock image or a low-resolution screenshot rather than a photo of the actual item for sale.
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the specific transmission being offered for sale.
risks.if_unproven: as a generic used transmission of unknown condition

risks.risk: The transmission may be a used part from a different vehicle or a used unit from a different brand.
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's identification plate (usually found on the side or back of the case).

risks.risk: The transmission may be incomplete, missing a clutch, or have internal mechanical damage.
risks.proof: A video showing the transmission being shifted through all gears.
risks.if_unproven: as a non-functional or incomplete unit

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the manufacturer's identification plate on the transmission case.
Photo of the specific transmission being sold to confirm it is the one listed.
Video of the transmission being shifted through all gears to confirm it is functional.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
